stemMd: Why could a lane appear quiet on the old map despite disturbing residents at night?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The original afternoon roadside measurements did not capture brief late-night events in that lane.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The researchers deliberately deleted all loud readings.

options.label: C
options.textMd: All residents misunderstood the units used by sound meters.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Music venues were quieter at night than during the afternoon.

explanationMd: Link the old survey's time and location restrictions to the missed events. Afternoon roadside recordings could miss short nighttime sounds on residential lanes.

distractorRationale.b: The passage identifies a design limitation, not deliberate deletion.
distractorRationale.c: No misunderstanding of units is reported.
distractorRationale.d: The passage describes intense nighttime peaks near some venues.
